title: Case Discussion Rubric
description: For threaded clinical case discussions. Volume is not the metric. Whether your posts move the case forward is the metric.

levels.descriptor: Agreement, disagreement, or restatement with no added clinical or informatics content.
Adds an example, a guideline citation, a standard, or a clarification.
Advances the case: a new framing, a counter-example, a relevant SAFER guide, or a question the thread had not asked.
Reframes the disagreement so participants who held opposite views recognize the actual sociotechnical crux.
Replies that signal agreement or disagreement.
Replies that quote what was said and respond to its strongest version.
Replies that change the original poster's mind, or that publicly update the responder's own.
Posted identifying details. Even one slip is a 1 here.
No identifiers, but the abstraction is loose enough that the case is partly identifiable.
Clean abstraction. Could not be traced to a specific patient or institution.
Clean abstraction AND the writer makes the abstraction itself a teaching point for peers.
Curious AND willing to be wrong in public.
